Asset type: Unreal Engine game VFX texture, single centered circular ring mask sprite.
Primary request: one clean white circular band centered exactly in a square canvas. A hollow circle with an entirely transparent center, consistent medium band thickness, smooth circular contour. Smooth antialiased edges with a tiny soft alpha feather only at the inner and outer edges, solid white body.
